day_shape: 51 items: Trump pauses US naval escorts in Hormuz claiming 'great progress', Axios/Reuters report a one-page US-Iran deal within 48 hours, CENTCOM says 52 vessels turned back, IDF strikes ~25 Hezbollah sites, heavy regime messaging denying capitulation.

threads.label: US-Iran one-page deal reporting
threads.summary: Axios and Reuters reported the US and Iran are closing in on a one-page memo to end the war, with Tehran expected to respond within 48 hours. Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri said Iran's response has not yet been submitted, and Defa Press called the uranium-removal element 'utterly false'.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz escort operation pauses
threads.summary: Trump paused US naval escorts through the Strait of Hormuz citing progress in Iran talks, while CENTCOM said 52 commercial vessels had been directed to turn back and South Korea suspended its review of joining the operation. A French vessel was reported attacked transiting the Strait, and Iran's Navy said safe passage would resume under Iranian regulations.

threads.label: Regime messaging on negotiations and resilience
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried statements from Parliament's speaker, armed forces spokesman Shekarchi, President Pezeshkian and commentators framing US pressure as economic warfare and rejecting suggestions of Iranian retreat. Outlets also reported reconstruction underway at four South Pars gas refineries and damaged oil facilities.

threads.label: Lebanon front: Hezbollah-IDF exchanges
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck approximately 25 Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon and reported two soldiers wounded in a Hezbollah drone attack. Defa Press reported nine killed or wounded in an Israeli strike on Zlaya, Baalbek, and Lebanese speaker Nabih Berri said Lebanon would be part of any Iran-US agreement.

threads.label: China drone-component supply reporting
threads.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported Chinese companies continue to ship motors, chips and fibre optic cables sustaining Iranian and Russian drone production despite US sanctions. Iran International and IRIB both relayed the WSJ findings, citing Shahed drone unit costs of $20,000–$50,000.

events.title_en: Negotiation has no relation to imposition and threat. Ismail Bagheri, Foreign Ministry spokesman, wrote in a message on X network:
events.summary_en: Negotiation has no relation to imposition and threat. Ismail Bagheri, Foreign Ministry spokesman, wrote in a message on X network: The concept of 'negotiation' requires genuine and sincere effort at dialogue with the aim of settling disputes (International Court of Justice, judgement of 1 April 2011). Therefore 'negotiation' requires seriousness and good faith. 'Negotiation' is neither 'argumentation', nor 'dictation', nor 'extortion' nor 'compulsion'.

events.title_en: Gas refinery reconstruction operations begin
events.summary_en: Gas refinery reconstruction operations begin. Based on managerial decision and with the oil minister's prudence, the reconstruction of two refineries has been fully assigned to the National Gas Company, which, with careful planning, has begun reconstruction work so that these gas refineries become operational at the scheduled time. Currently, all power plants in the country are operating at full capacity using natural gas

events.title_en: Any mischief by enemies will be met with a firm response
events.summary_en: Any mischief by enemies will be met with a firm response. The spokesman of the parliamentary commission on national security and foreign policy, on his personal page in cyberspace, reacted to Axios news agency's claim that Iran and America are approaching a memorandum of understanding aimed at ending the war, and wrote: The Axios text is a list of American wishes, not a reality. Americans will not achieve in a lost war what they did not achieve in face-to-face negotiations. Iran has its finger on the trigger and is ready; if they do not surrender and do not give the necessary concessions, or if they or their lackeys want to cause mischief, we will give a firm and regrettable response.

events.title_en: 9 killed and wounded in Zionist regime air strike on eastern Lebanon
events.summary_en: 9 killed and wounded in Zionist regime air strike on eastern Lebanon. The Medical Emergency Centre affiliated with Lebanon's Ministry of Health reported the death and wounding of 9 Lebanese during Israeli fighter jets' attack on eastern Lebanon. The Zionist regime's attack on the Zlaya village in Baalbek in eastern Lebanon resulted in the death of four people, including two women and an elderly man, and the wounding of five people, including one child and three women. Al-Akhbar also reported the death of the mayor of Zlaya and his wife during the Zionist regime's attack on his home.

events.title_en: Why the operation called the 'Freedom Project' in the Strait of Hormuz failed
events.summary_en: Why the operation called the 'Freedom Project' in the Strait of Hormuz failed. Trump's withdrawal from the 'Freedom Project' operation in the Strait of Hormuz was the result of operational failure, field pressures, lack of global backing, potential costs of engagement and diplomatic necessities.
